subject: Day 34: end of week 5; daycare deposits due
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 34. Closing out week five. Crying intensity is at or near peak; head control and social smiles are visibly improving. The next administrative cluster is the maternal postpartum visit and the 2-month well visit.

Action items
- Pay any daycare waitlist or enrollment deposits this week so the spot does not move; reserve at the top of your shortlist. ChildCare.gov directory: https://www.childcare.gov/
- Pre-write questions for Anoushka's 6-week postpartum visit: pelvic floor recovery, mood and EPDS rescreen, return to exercise, contraception, breastfeeding plan, return-to-work date. ACOG on postpartum birth control: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/postpartum-birth-control
- Confirm the 2-month well visit is booked and the vaccine consent is understood (HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1). AAP on immunizations: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/immunizations/aap-policy-on-immunizations/
- Restock pantry and freezer for the peak-crying week ahead.
- Continue the feeding log.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Peak evening fussiness; head control improving; smiles consolidating.
- [low concern] Quiet startle, hiccups, wet sneezing.
- [monitor] Forceful arching, painful spit-up, or feeding refusal — raise at the upcoming visit.
- [call within 24h] Sustained feeding refusal. Bloody-mucus stool. Fewer than six wet diapers per day.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusing all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunities
- Tummy time 20-30 minutes a day across bouts. AAP HealthyChildren on tummy time: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Back-to-Sleep-Tummy-to-Play.aspx
- Hold him at a mirror at his eye level for 60-90 seconds during a calm window.
- Take conversational turns with every coo and squeal. Romeo et al., Psych Science 2018: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29442613/
- Outdoor stroller walk for 20-30 minutes most days.

Upcoming
- Day 35-41: peak PURPLE crying.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit.
- Day 56-70: 2-month well visit and first vaccines.

Developmental milestone check-in
Tap any link to mark it complete. View or change others at https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones

- First social smile (responding to a face, not gas)
  AAP window: day 28-60
  What to look for: Smile in response to someone smiling or talking to them, not a reflexive gas smile. Hallmark social milestone.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/first-social-smile/complete

- Follows a moving object with eyes past midline
  AAP window: day 28-60
  What to look for: Hold a small object 8-12 inches away and slowly move side to side. Eyes should cross the body midline.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/tracks-moving-object/complete

- Seems happy to see you when you walk up
  AAP window: day 28-60
  What to look for: Recognition + positive affect. Often accompanied by limb-pumping excitement.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/seems-happy-to-see-you/complete

- Calms when picked up or spoken to
  AAP window: day 14-60
  What to look for: Early co-regulation. Not the same as stopping crying immediately — look for any shift in state.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/2-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/calms-with-soothing/complete

- Briefly lifts head during tummy time
  AAP window: day 14-60
  What to look for: Few seconds of head lift, even with bobble, counts. Builds neck strength for later head control.
  Source: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Back-to-Sleep-Tummy-to-Play.aspx
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/brief-head-lift/complete
